title: Nūn Sākinah, Tanwīn and Mīm Sākinah
titleArabic: أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين والميم الساكنة

sections.title: Mīm Sākinah
sections.hint: Before another mīm it merges, with ghunna (idghām shafawī); before ب it is hidden, with ghunna (ikhfāʾ shafawī); before every other letter it is said clearly (iẕhār shafawī).

sections.title: Nūn Sākinah and Tanwīn — Iẕhār Ḥalqī
sections.hint: Before the six throat letters — ء ه ع ح غ خ — the nūn sākinah or tanwīn is said clearly, with no ghunna. The tanwīn is written stacked.

sections.title: Nūn Sākinah and Tanwīn — Idghām with Ghunna
sections.hint: Before ي ن م و the nūn or tanwīn merges into the next letter and the ghunna stays, on the merged letter.

sections.title: Nūn Sākinah and Tanwīn — Idghām without Ghunna
sections.titleArabic: النون الساكنة والتنوين — الإدغام بغير غنة
sections.hint: Before ل and ر the nūn or tanwīn merges completely — a doubled letter with no ghunna at all.

sections.title: Nūn Sākinah and Tanwīn — Ikhfāʾ Ḥaqīqī
sections.hint: Before the fifteen remaining letters the nūn is hidden: the tongue does not touch, and only the ghunna is heard while the mouth shapes the next letter. The ghunna is heavy before ص ض ط ق ظ and light before the rest. The tanwīn is written staggered. صِفۡ ذَا ثَنَا كَمۡ جَادَ شَخۡصٌ قَدۡ سَمَا  •  دُمۡ طَيِّبًا زِدۡ فِي تُقًى ضَعۡ ظَالِمَا

sections.title: Nūn Sākinah and Tanwīn — Iqlāb
sections.hint: Before ب the nūn sākinah or tanwīn turns into a hidden mīm, with ghunna. The Mushaf writes a small mīm in place of the sukoon, and the tanwīn gives up one of its two marks for it.
